title: VK-only Write Single Register
purpose: Provide a distinct mutation-friendly register-write request that reaches common receive and reply handling with a compact fixed-size body.
expected_behavior: The server should parse the request and normally echo a Write Single Register response or return a protocol exception for unsupported addressing.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches the request body.
Function code 06 carries one address and one 16-bit register value.
issue_safety_notes: The request preserves the issue-relevant server receive/reply pathway without copying any reported crash bytes. Crash behavior is not assumed; issue descriptions and suspected causes remain unverified reference evidence.
